title: Review of evoloop: Supported for I, B, D, H. A side-4 founder's clade drives a side-11 founder's clade extinct in 5,000-6,500 steps on 5/5 fresh seeds. In a neutral pair of two side-11 founders, one clade fixes too, but later (14,000-24,500 steps) and on either side. On one neutral seed, small kinds arise and sweep twice within 40k steps
summary: A labkit re-run of c16's world.py (unchanged, seed 21, 300^2, 20k steps) gives 240 persistent splits, max generation 29 and merge/split 0.40, matching the claim. For H I ran a head-to-head assay with c16's evo_track.py. world.py gains one key, ms, a list of founder core sides (otherwise identical). Arm mix plants one side-11 and one side-4 loop; arm neu plants two side-11 loops; each runs 40k steps on 300^2, on seeds 21-23 and 25-26 (seed 24 is void in both arms: the founders overlap and dissolve at t=20). clades.py assigns every loop to its founder's clade through the parent links. In mix, the side-4 clade wins 5/5: the side-11 clade is extinct at 5,000-6,500 steps and the side-4 clade holds 120-160 loops. In neu, one founder clade also fixes by drift in a population of 35-50 loops, but only at 14,000-24,500 steps, and the winner is the first founder on 3 seeds and the second on 2. Under neutrality, 5/5 for the side-4 clade has probability 1/32, and it fixes 2-4x faster. On neu seed 26, side-4 loops arise from side-11 parents (first small-kind births at t=2460-3420) and reach 99 of 108 loops by t=20k, then side-2 loops reach 178 of 193 by t=40k. That repeats c16's sequence of sweeps by small kinds on a fresh seed, 4x faster on this smaller torus. Kind changes of living loops: 271 against 18,576 births (1.5%).

verdicts.limitation: In the mix arm the kinds are planted, so it tests selection between heritable kinds, not their origin; the origin of small kinds during the run is shown on neu seed 26 and in c16's runs. The neutral arm is a symmetric founder pair, not an identical-event twin, and small populations (35-50 side-11 loops) drift to fixation too, so the evidence for selection is the direction (5/5) and the 2-4x faster fixation. Side-4 loops pack about 3x more loops into the torus, so part of the advantage is space per loop, not only birth rate. I did not re-run the SDSR control. Event logs (runs/*.json, 31 MB) are left out; the commands are evo_track.py world.py '{"ms":[15,8]}' (or [15,15]) 40000 <seed> 300.
